title: 中国AI性价比：美国高端模型之外，机器人能源优势怎么选？
speaker: Marcel LaChalle

segments.en: So where does that leave Asia? I mean, obviously the region has benefited from this whole AI build out. How do you separate between AI and on AI, or winners and losers right now? It's just hard. A lot of investors will continue asking, oh, should I just try and build a non-AI, just to be trying to avoid all this volatility? That is very tough right now.
segments.zh: 那么亚洲处于什么位置？显然该地区从整个AI建设中受益。你现在如何区分AI与非AI，或者赢家与输家？这很难。很多投资者会继续问，我是不是应该尝试构建一个非AI组合，只是为了避开所有这些波动？目前这非常困难。

segments.en: But to us, it's not about avoiding AI completely, because it's impossible to do that in nowadays. But to identify the stages, different stages, before it was like from the hyperscaler, so we say it's AI spenders, and now it's the AI owners, like the hardware that build out the companies in Taiwan, Korea, and Japan that are benefiting it in it.
segments.zh: 但对我们来说，不是要完全避开AI，因为如今这不可能做到。而是要识别不同阶段，之前是超大规模企业，我们称之为AI支出者，现在是AI拥有者，比如在台湾、韩国和日本建设硬件的公司正在从中受益。

segments.en: But we need to think a few steps ahead, so right now it may be the AI users into various sectors like healthcare and also into robotics, where China has a competitive advantage.
segments.zh: 但我们需要提前思考几步，所以现在可能是AI用户进入各个领域，比如医疗保健，以及机器人领域，中国在那里具有竞争优势。

segments.en: And one key thing, one interesting thing is a lot of us acknowledge how US is good at the premium models, like the machines, three stars, etc. But China is good at its value for money.
segments.zh: 一个关键点，一个有趣的事情是，我们很多人都承认美国擅长高端模型，比如那些顶级机器。但中国擅长性价比。

segments.en: And to us, we do not need to go to machines three stars every day. And sometimes for me, a normal user, I'm just happy with a good model, decent model, that can satisfy my daily usage. So those with value for money will actually be an interesting proposition, an interesting higher increase in demand going forward as well.
segments.zh: 对我们来说，我们不需要每天都用顶级机器。有时对我这个普通用户来说，一个能满足日常使用的好模型、像样的模型就让我满意了。所以那些具有性价比的将实际上是一个有趣的命题，未来需求也会有趣地增长。

segments.en: And the key for next step, other than from AI owners to spender to AI users like robotics, I think it's also about the energy security and also the energy scarcity, given China will have a competitive advantage in that as well.
segments.zh: 下一步的关键，除了从AI拥有者到支出者再到像机器人这样的AI用户之外，我认为还涉及能源安全和能源稀缺，因为中国在这方面也将具有竞争优势。

segments.en: The fourth quarter is coming, any specific risk to be attuned to?
segments.zh: 第四季度即将到来，有什么需要特别关注的具体风险吗？
